title: Basic Adverbs
description: Common adverbs of manner, time, and place
descriptionRussian: Наречия образа действия, времени и места
intro: Adverbs describe how, when, or where an action happens. Quick test: if a word describes a VERB (an action), it is an adverb. If it describes a NOUN (a thing), it is an adjective. Compare: хороший день (good day, adjective describes the noun) vs. Я хорошо говорю (I speak well, adverb describes the verb). Many adverbs end in -о and look like adjectives, but they never change form. No gender, no plural, no cases!
rules: Adverbs describe verbs (actions). Adjectives describe nouns (things). Example: быстрый поезд (fast train, adjective) vs. Он бегает быстро (He runs fast, adverb).
Adverbs never change form. No gender, number, or case endings needed.
Manner adverbs answer 'how?': хорошо (well), плохо (badly), быстро (quickly), медленно (slowly).
Time adverbs answer 'when?': сегодня (today), завтра (tomorrow), вчера (yesterday), сейчас (now).
Place adverbs answer 'where?': здесь/тут (here), там (there), везде (everywhere), дома (at home).

items.prompt: Она говорит по-русски очень _____. (She speaks Russian very well.)
items.explanation: Use the adverb хорошо (well), not the adjective хороший (good).

items.prompt: _____ я иду в магазин. (Today I'm going to the store.)
items.promptEnglish: Today I'm going to the store.
items.explanation: Сегодня (today) indicates the action is happening today.

items.prompt: Мой друг живёт _____. (My friend lives there.)
items.explanation: Там (there) indicates a place away from the speaker.

items.prompt: _____ я был в кино. (Yesterday I was at the movies.)
items.promptEnglish: Yesterday I was at the movies.
items.explanation: Вчера (yesterday) matches the past tense был (was).

items.prompt: Она _____ понимает по-русски. (She understands Russian poorly.)
items.explanation: Плохо (poorly/badly) is the opposite of хорошо (well).

blanks: Он бегает очень _____. (He runs very fast.)

minimalPairs.context: Это _____ книга. (This is a good book.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Use adjective хорошая to describe the noun книга. Хорошо is an adverb.
Use adverb хорошо to describe how she reads. Хорошая is an adjective.
